_comment: A read-only knowledge-graph endpoint: graphersal --graph kb.gstore --read-only --server --mcp --mcp-config examples/mcp-kb-readonly.json. Only GQL, the schema and the saved queries of the folder kb (each a tool of its own), short descriptions, short instructions. Measure it: graphersal mcp-cost --graph kb.gstore --read-only --mcp-config examples/mcp-kb-readonly.json

instructions.text: A read-only knowledge graph of this project. Start with the saved-query tools: they answer the common questions (search by meaning, a symbol by name, where something is used, what a change touches). For anything else read the schema (get_schema) and write a GQL query (gql; what it supports: resource graphersal://gql-reference). Answers are compact JSON; large ones are paged: the note at the end names the next page's offset.
